text:
maya (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands about hybrid + travel ops. Dropping fast answers here.

nina (Eng): Are meal stipends covered for satellite weeks?

maya (People Ops): Yes — small daily meal stipend applies when on-site >1 day. Use ops:meals cost code and attach receipts for hospitality over $50.

devin (Sales): If I bring a client to the office for half-day, do we cover lunch?

carlos (People Ops): Client lunches ok with sponsor approval; travel for clients is not covered. Submit visitor form and note sponsor.

rebecca (People Ops): Heads up: managers need to approve travel >3 days. Use the travel request form so Finance can pre-authorize budgets.

nina (Eng): Emergency travel (family issue) while on a trip — what then?

maya (People Ops): We fast-track emergency exceptions. DM me or Carlos, include dates and a short note. We'll cover last-minute changes where justified.

offsite-bot: Poll posted "Preferred satellite week" Mon/Tue/Wed  results in 24h.

maya (People Ops): I'll summarize and pin a 1-pager in #people-ops. DM for edge cases. :wave:
